record.name: Alamo Contracting
record.description: Alamo Contracting is a Doig River First Nation-owned contracting firm based out of the Rose Prairie area. Alamo has been in business for over eight years and has over 30 years of operator experience. The firm is committed to being a safe, reliable, quality-driven and cost-effective provider of road maintenance and construction services. It ensures to continually strive to improve performance in meeting the needs of its clients, shareholders, employees and communities.     Alamo offers a variety of contracting services and heavy machinery for projects in the area.
